symptom: A genuine parse error on a short lowercase MDL keyword/identifier (`mismatched input 'on'`, `'in'`, `'as'`, `'to'`, `'by'`, …) is misdiagnosed with the "unescaped apostrophe" hint, sending the user to look for a quote that isn't there
cause: `looksLikeUnescapedApostrophe` matched **any** 1–4 char lowercase token as a contraction leftover, so real short keywords tripped it
insight: Match only the fixed contraction-suffix set (`s`/`t`/`d`/`m`/`re`/`ve`/`ll` — the leftovers from it's/don't/he'd/I'm/you're/we've/you'll), not arbitrary short lowercase words. Real apostrophe errors still hint; `on`/`in`/`as`/`to`/`by` no longer do. Findings #4
